plugin.note: Adamant dragon strategy: draconic dragonbane target with Earth weakness. Handle poison splats and Ruby-bolt style ranged special.

mechanics: Adamant dragons use melee, ranged, magic, and dragonfire.
Poison projectile splits in a 5x5 area and is reduced by poison protection.
Ruby-bolt style ranged special ignores Protect from Missiles and deals 20% of current player hitpoints.
They have 50% earth spell vulnerability and the draconic attribute.

methods.label: Dragonfire protection
methods.summary: Use full dragonfire protection in Lithkren Vault.
requiredOrKeyItems: Super antifire or shield plus antifire
steps: Access Lithkren Vault after Dragon Slayer II.
Keep poison protection active to reduce poison projectile damage.

methods.label: Special attacks
methods.summary: Move from poison splats and manage current hitpoints for the Ruby-bolt style special.
steps: Move three squares away from the poison projectile landing tile to avoid the splatter.
Keep hitpoints around 40-50 if comfortable to reduce Ruby-bolt style special damage.
Use dragonbane melee, ranged, or Magic to finish kills.

styleOptions.label: Melee dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter lance or stab melee setup.

styleOptions.label: Ranged dragonbane
styleOptions.summary: Dragon hunter crossbow or Twisted bow setup.

styleOptions.label: Earth Magic
styleOptions.summary: Tumeken's shadow, dragon hunter wand, or Earth spell setup.

body:
# Adamant dragon

Draconic dragonbane target with Earth weakness. Handle poison splats and Ruby-bolt style ranged special.
